description: This file defines the LazyOpenStream class in the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 implementation, which lazily opens a file stream only upon IO operations.

classes.name: LazyOpenStream
classes.description: A class that implements StreamInterface, providing a lazily opened file stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes with filename and mode, deferring stream creation until first use.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates the underlying stream lazily when required.
